corrected_fixture_failures.analysis: All new reclaim scenarios passed; the later owner-SIGKILL fixture assumed it exclusively owned waitpid for the child. The preceding file-worker replacement left the original owner destructor reaper waiting on the same surviving PID. Isolate the subsequent owner-death test with a fresh file worker after every recovery guard has been returned or expired, so that it signals and reaps its newly spawned child without a competing reaper.
